verses.text: Hence, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, carefully consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession, Jesus,

verses.text: For this [One] has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, by as much as the [one] having built it has more honor than the house [itself].

verses.text: For every house is built by someone, but the [One] having built everything [is] God.
